name: 3D Voxel Sandbox
agentBrief: A complete voxel survival and building sandbox (Godot 4.6, GDScript only, Forward+, Jolt physics). ENTRY: res://scenes/main_menu.tscn — the menu titles the game VOXEL CREATIONS and offers SINGLE PLAYER (resumes an existing save via WorldSave.has_save(), else starts fresh) and CREATE NEW WORLD; scenes/loading.tscn covers world generation. INPUT IS DEFINED IN CODE, NOT project.godot: there is NO [input] section — scripts/core/input_actions.gd registers every action at runtime and players rebind keys in-game through Esc -> Settings, backed by scripts/core/game_settings.gd. Do not add actions to project.godot; add them in input_actions.gd or they will not exist for the rebinding UI. Controls: WASD move, Ctrl sprint, Space jump (double-tap toggles creative fly), 1-9/scroll hotbar, left click mine/attack, right click place, Q/E switch weapon, G eat, C crafting, M map, J advancements, F5 first/third person toggle, F3 debug stats, Esc pause. WORLD (scripts/world/, the bulk of the template): chunk.gd + chunk_manager.gd stream terrain with GREEDY MESHING and OFF-THREAD chunk builds — the perf spine, do not rewrite it; voxel_types.gd is the data-driven block registry; structures.gd scatters discoverable ruined towers, guarded crypts and treasure caches with loot; day_night.gd, weather.gd (continuous evolving climate with seasons, rain, snow, sandstorms, thunder), ambience.gd (fireflies, pollen, shooting stars), tree_models.gd, block_drop.gd, world_save.gd, and farm.gd + crop.gd for farming. SEVEN NAMED WORLD-UNEASE SYSTEMS give this template its identity and are worth preserving when reskinning: mirage.gd (heat-shimmer mirages and false oases), oddities.gd (The Wrong Block), hauntfields.gd, chronicle.gd (The Chronicle Stone), echo_sounding.gd, hollows.gd (The Hunger of Hollows) and mimic_builder.gd (Doppelganger Tracks). PLAYER (scripts/player/): player.gd (first/third person, hunger and health), inventory.gd (27 slots), tool_holder.gd and weapon_holder.gd equipping from weapon_registry.gd — a STATIC table of 38 weapons and tools across wood/stone/iron/diamond tiers where several entries share one .glb model; adding gear means a model plus a table row, nothing scans directories at runtime. ENTITIES (scripts/entities/): creature.gd is the shared base, animal.gd and fauna.gd the passive biome life (birds, fish, reptiles, farm animals with positional audio), hostile_mob.gd the night threats — normal, fast runner and brute zombies, blood moons, cave lurkers, daylight burning. UI (scripts/ui/): hud, crafting_ui, chest_ui, minimap, pause_menu, loading, item_icons and ui_theme (theme centrally there). CORE (scripts/core/): main.gd, game_state.gd, advancements.gd, audio_ducker.gd. ASSETS: block faces come from a single atlas (assets/textures/blocks/atlas.png) so new block art is an atlas edit plus a voxel_types.gd entry. Model textures are embedded as Godot-compatible WebP inside the shipped GLB files; generated import sidecars and duplicate loose model textures are not source assets. CUSTOMIZE BY: adding block types in voxel_types.gd, gear rows in weapon_registry.gd, crops in crop.gd, creatures on creature.gd, structures in structures.gd, and retuning generation constants — do not rewrite the chunk streaming, meshing or registry spine.

motion.notes: Existing model animation is preserved; gameplay acceptance does not require generating new motion.

probes.description: Boots into the voxel main menu without script errors.
A new world reaches streamed playable terrain.
The avatar can move, mine one block and place one block.
A block edit persists across world reload.

scope.objective: Create or resume a world, gather resources, craft tools, build, survive hostile nights, and preserve world edits.

userFacing.tagline: Mine, build, farm and survive a living voxel world that quietly unsettles you.
highlights: Streamed voxel world with meadow, forest, jungle, desert, snow, mountain, ocean and river biomes
Day/night cycle plus evolving weather and seasons: rain, snow, sandstorms and thunder
Seven eerie world systems — mirages, wrong blocks, hauntfields, doppelganger tracks and more
Full survival loop: mining tiers, crafting, smelting, farming, cooking, hunger and armor
Night sieges of zombies, blood moons, cave lurkers and daylight burning
Discoverable structures with loot — ruined towers, guarded crypts, treasure caches
Biome fauna with positional audio, 27-slot inventory, minimap, advancements and save/load
Optimized with greedy meshing and off-thread chunk builds for a locked frame rate
